purpose: Context is captured once per player and confirmed per session. It is never inferred from video appearance (body size, perceived age, gender presentation). It feeds context_gates in fault definitions, sets the reading level and tone of player_message, and determines which comparison population coach_reference_ranges may draw from. Context is self-reported/coach-reported, editable, and never used to auto-detect age from imagery.

capture_points.player_profile: collected once at account creation, editable anytime, required before first analysis
capture_points.session_context: confirmed at upload time, defaults to last known profile values, can be overridden per session

age_band.notes: u10/10_to_12/13_to_15/16_to_17 trigger the minor safeguarding profile in safeguarding.json regardless of any other setting.

player_level.notes: Drives which technique_family variations are treated as ACCEPTABLE_VARIATION vs FAULT_SUSPECTED, and the density of the default overlay recipe.

dominant_hand.notes: Required to correctly mirror all L/R overlay markers (ELBOW_ANGLE_L etc.) and phase-relevant side.

adaptive_play.notes: When set, phase_model timing and base_of_support/recovery faults are re-baselined against adaptive norms in coach_reference_ranges rather than standing-player norms; ambulatory-only faults (e.g. split-step, landing_recovery) are suppressed, not scored as failures.

guardian_linked_account.notes: See safeguarding.json for consent and access rules this gates.

preferred_language.notes: Selects the localized player_message/coach_message_template string set. See VISUALIZATION_SPEC.md localization section.

session_goal.notes: return_after_break softens severity_policy escalation for one session and suppresses recurrence-based escalation until minimum_comparable_strokes resets.

camera_setup.view: one of camera_suitability.json keys, confirmed by engine's view classifier not just self-report
camera_setup.frame_rate_fps: type: number, gates slow-motion-dependent faults (e.g. racket-drop timing) below 50fps

court_surface.notes: Affects footwork/slide-recovery expectations, not stroke mechanics faults.

self_reported_state.notes: Purely contextual flags shown to the coach and used to soften severity_policy, never used to infer or imply a medical condition.

context_gate_application_rule: A fault's context_gates (defined per-fault in config/faults/*.json) are evaluated against player_profile + session_context before a fault can move from FAULT_SUSPECTED to FAULT_CONFIRMED. A missing required context field forces measurement_status = CONTEXT_DEPENDENT and blocks scoring, per no_score_conditions in confidence_policy.json.
explicitly_excluded_from_context: perceived age, gender, ethnicity, or body type inferred from video
any health/diagnostic classification beyond the player's own free-text self-report
